document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You successfully jump the shaft, only to discover that the corridor 
beyond is a dead end. Behind you, on the other side of the 
shaft, a creature emerges into the glow of a patch of moss—see 
entry 304 for a description, then return here (note that you are 
currently at 348). 
It stares at you, a basket in its hand, leering crazily. You finally 
understand that it is just waiting. You can wait, too, at 355, or 
you can try going down the intervening shaft, at 369.
(303)
